svg.text: A merge request that only changes deployment files does
not wait for the test suite
Scenario: Deployment paths preserve configuration and test coverage

g.text: Given a deployment policy with literal paths and dotenv overrides
The development override wins over the multiline default list.
Then unsafe paths keep the full pipeline and the effective dotenv value is read without
After checking the override and its empty value, the override file is cleared. The displayed default list produces a
reduced pattern after the contract tests pass. Naming project/Taskfile.yml prints a warning and the full-pipeline
fallback. Reading the effective list never edits the pipeline YAML.
